name: Grib
title: the Unbanded
examine: A goblin who walked away from the camp. The others don't wave.
lines: Grib not with camp. Camp throws rocks. Grib throws better, so Grib LEFT.
Shiny-hat people not stab Grib yet. Grib counts that as friendship.
You want know goblin secrets? Secret one: rocks. Secret two: MORE rocks.
